# Windows Game Explorer v2.8.0

> Icon overhaul, physical Games folder, per-user registration, Defender mitigation, and documentation audit.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| **Release Version** | `v2.8.0` |
| **Release Date** | 2026-10-29 |
| **Release Classification** | Packaged Application Release |
| **License** | [MIT](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) |
| **Release Channel** | Stable / Production |

---

## 📋 Overview

**Windows Game Explorer v2.8.0** overhauls the icon system, introduces a physical Games folder for game shortcuts, makes registration fully per-user (no admin required), and adds Windows Defender false-positive mitigation documentation and tooling.

This release also introduces a physical backing folder (`%USERPROFILE%\Games`) for game shortcuts, migrates app data to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Game Explorer\`, and provides `.lnk` scanning so the Games tab displays physical shortcuts alongside database entries.

---

## ⭐ Highlights

- **Icon Overhaul** — App icon now uses an on-disk `.ico` file (`game-explorer.ico`) instead of being embedded in the DLL, fixing the issue where the DLL overrode Explorer's process icon.
- **Physical Games Folder** — Created `%USERPROFILE%\Games` as a physical backing folder with `Desktop.ini` junction point. `.lnk` shortcuts created during scan for each game.
- **Per-User Registration** — Registration no longer requires Administrator rights (HKCU-only). Service uses user-level scheduled task.
- **Windows Defender Mitigation** — SCM strings verified, code signing script, CI workflow, winget manifest, troubleshooting docs.
- **`.lnk` Scanning** — `ScanGameShortcuts()` added to discover games from physical folder shortcuts.
- **Details View Enhancements** — Shows developer, publisher, rating, playtime, and storefront icon.

## 🔄 What's Changed

### ✅ Added
- **Physical Games folder** — `%USERPROFILE%\Games` created as a normal folder with `Desktop.ini` (controller icon). `.lnk` shortcuts created for each detected game during scan.
- **`.lnk` scanning** — `ScanGameShortcuts()` added to `ScanAllInstalledGames()` to discover games from physical folder shortcuts.
- **Per-user registration** — HKCU-only registration, no admin required. Service uses user-level scheduled task.
- **Code signing infrastructure** — `generate-cert.ps1` for self-signed dev certs, `submit-to-wdsi.ps1` for Microsoft Defender false-positive submission.
- **Winget manifest** — created and validated for `HELIX-Origin.WindowsGameExplorer`.
- **Release workflow** — automated release with signing, packaging, WDSI submission, and winget PR.
- **Troubleshooting docs** — Windows Defender false positive section with folders, executables, registry keys, PowerShell exclusions, and submission instructions.

### 🔄 Changed
- App data root moved from `%USERPROFILE%\Game Explorer` to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Game Explorer`.
- Icon swapped from DLL-embedded to on-disk `.ico` (`game-explorer.ico`).
- Windows 10 icon renamed to `game-explorer-icon-alt.ico`.
- `shell:games` shortcut replaced with `/e,::{CLSID}` for modern Windows.
- Service failure actions set to `SC_ACTION_NONE` (no auto-restart on kill).
- "Manage Metadata" → "Manage Games" in UI strings.
- Details view now shows developer, publisher, rating, playtime, and storefront icon.
- Game cards show developer instead of storefront as subtext.

### 🐛 Fixed
- Service auto-restart on force-kill fixed.
- IndieGala platform bloc (scanner blocking, notifications filtering).
- Legacy command bar documented as known issue.
